proposals.evidence: Full *ut-sthāti section 1 gives Prakrit uṭṭhaï, Nepali uṭhnu and the eastern Hindi uṭh-/ūṭh- rise verb. These bare uṭh responses are imperatives/stems of “get up”, not the past participle *ut-sthita (1907). Responses containing negative particles, auxiliaries or perfect endings are excluded from this rule.
